description:
Mark yourself away (PTO, holiday, sick or other) for every day from startDate to endDate, past or future. Refusals: availability_overlap (it shares a day with another of your spans, a calendar-created day included; conflictingEntry names it, so change that one with anyforge_update_my_availability instead), end_before_start, span_too_long (over 366 days), invalid_kind, invalid_date, insufficient_role.

Always your own spans, the ones Settings → Capacity → Availability lists; there is no argument that names anyone else. Needs the role that adds a span in the Console (Operator or higher). Days a span covers are not counted by the "Log your time" reminder; time already booked on them stays booked.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

kind.description: pto, holiday, sick or other. On-call is working time and is not set here.

note.description: A short note, such as "Family trip".

name: anyforge_add_my_availability
title: Add my availability
